mathematical_definition: Tercile bucket (0=low, 1=mid, 2=high) of ewma_vol: daily-resampled (last value per day), then rolling(252, min_periods=60).apply(lambda w: searchsorted(percentile(w, [33.3, 66.7]), w[-1])), shifted by 1 day to avoid same-day lookahead, then ffill-reindexed back onto the intraday bar timeline
numerical_stability_notes: np.searchsorted against 2 percentile thresholds computed from the trailing 252-day window; ill-defined (NaN) until the rolling min_periods=60 gate is satisfied. Batch/replay implementation resamples ewma_vol to '1D' via pandas -- Task 20's DailyBuffer and Task 22's live_engine.py wiring are required for the live path to reproduce this exactly.
missing_value_policy: NaN until at least 60 daily observations of ewma_vol are available (min_periods=60), and for any intraday bar before the first daily tercile is computed; ffill thereafter within each day
